name: How To Be Saved
overview: Scripture reveals that salvation is secured through faith in Jesus Christ, as belief in Him grants eternal life while unbelief results in condemnation. This faith is accompanied by repentance and baptism, which are necessary for the remission of sins and receiving the Holy Spirit. Being born of water and the Spirit is essential to enter God's kingdom, highlighting the transformative nature of salvation. All people have sinned and fall short of God's glory, making the gift of salvation through Christ's sacrifice the only means to be saved.
